name: Uninstaller leftovers
description: App-data folders that no installed program claims. Only the Uninstaller tool reads this pack; it never rates anything Safe, and folders outside your own app data are shown for information only.

rules.reason: No program in the Windows list of installed apps has a name that matches this folder, so it is probably left over from an app you removed. Names do not always match, so check before moving it to quarantine.
